lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 8-10 vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in 4-5 horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity blobs are positioned at the intersections of vertical light-intensity bands and horizontal trajectory lines, creating a geometric grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6 distinct high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, distributed primarily along the posterior half.

other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high density of smaller-diameter high-luminance blobs observed on the surface of the extended pectoral fin compared to the lateral flank.
